summary: No proposals today, so the trades change nothing and the 10% market-drop loss stays at -$22.59 (3.6% of $626.12 equity). Both bond sleeves (BND, IEF; 8.7% by bucket) are NEAR their stops. Every lot is short-term and the nearest long-term date is 2027-10-21, so there is no tax timing issue.
